content: RRF score = sum over channels of w_i/(k + rank_i). k=60 is the near-universal empirical default (Elasticsearch, Azure AI Search, ParadeDB, Chroma, MariaDB all default or recommend 60). k is a smoothing knob: low k (20-40) lets a single channel's #1 dominate; high k (80-100) rewards cross-channel consensus. Weighted RRF (WRRF) attaches a per-channel weight w_i applied before fusion, and query-type classifiers can swap weight profiles per query intent. Consensus: tune per-channel weights and per-channel candidate limits before touching k.
